title: Relaxing boat trip
text: It started with a friendly welcome from Anna who explained a few bits before we got on the boat.  Our captain was Moulay who was also friendly providing information and history at certain points of the trip but also left us to enjoy the views on our own.  Trip was 13/10/26 at 7.30pm .. it had been a hot day so by now was a comfortable warm temperature starting in the light and moving into dusk which meant we got to enjoy the lights along the banks and on the bridges.  Very relaxing with our sparkling wine.  Would definitely book again. Thank you

author: Taylor_S

title: Romantic Cruise Perfection
text: Absolutely fantastic experience! My wife and I did a private boat ride on the Guadalquivir River and it was one of the highlights of our time in Seville. The views were beautiful—historic bridges, colorful facades, and that golden sunset glow over the city. But what really made it special was our boat guide—he was incredible. Friendly, knowledgeable, and made the whole ride feel like something out of a movie. If you’re in Seville, don’t skip this. It’s peaceful, romantic, and just the right amount of magical.
author: Oye C
